Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The vehicle shall be exclusive use of this office and should not be used by the s

ervice provider for any other purpose, during office hours. The vehicle shall be made available on all days including Saturday, Sunday and Holidays, as and when required. The driver deputed on duty should carry valid driving license with proper dress code. The drivers shall be well conversant with the roads and routes of Rangat Area The driver shall always remain with vehicle during the entire timing of duty. In case of any need they should seek permission from the concerned officer During the period of operation, the drivers should not be changed frequently u nless desired/allowed by this office. The service provider shall provide vehicle of the make/model as per the terms of contract during the entire period of contract and should not change the vehi cle without prior information and approval from this office. The service provider should ensure that the vehicle is neat with clean turkey to wels, car perfume and should be in good running conditions for which no extra payment would be made. In case of any breakdown in the vehicle during duty hours, the service provider shall make alternate arrangement without delay. The driver shall observe all the entiquity and protocol while performing duty. If the service provider fails to deployment of vehicle/driver on any day without i nformation, penalty may be deducted as per GeM service level agreement. A daily record indicating time, millage and place of visit for each vehicle shall b e maintained in the log book which should be submitted to the concerned offic er of this office for scrutiny on day today basis. The driver should not carry any illegal substances (Mariguana, drugs of any kin d) and alcohol. Should comply with all road safety laws when operating the vehicle. The driver should be well disciplined and show gentle behavior with the official s. The bidder/Service Provider must upload the certificate of commercial permit issued by the State transport authority. The service provider shall ensure compliance with all labour laws in force. The bidder/Service Provider must upload document/certificate complying the B uyer Added Text Based ATC clauses along with Terms and conditions of the bid. A document confirming the availability of the service provider's office in the co nsignee's State/UT must be uploaded. .
